parrafo.es: Taller familiar en Cape Coral especializado en diagnóstico honesto, reparación general y Corvettes. Bob revisa tu auto, te explica el problema y el costo antes de tocar nada, y si no hace falta reparar algo, te lo dice.
parrafo.en: Family-run shop in Cape Coral specializing in honest diagnostics, general repair, and Corvettes. Bob looks at your car, tells you the problem and the cost up front, and if something doesn't need fixing, he says so.

hero.imagen_alt: Classic car in for service at Bob's Auto Repair of Cape Coral

parrafo_1.es: Bob Miller es el dueño y el mecánico: cuando llevas tu auto, hablas directo con la persona que lo va a reparar. Licencia de reparación de vehículos a motor de Florida MV92305.
parrafo_1.en: Bob Miller is the owner and the mechanic: when you bring your car in, you talk directly to the person doing the work. Florida Motor Vehicle Repair License MV92305.

parrafo_2.es: El taller se hizo conocido entre dueños de Corvette que lo encontraron recomendado en foros especializados, pero el trabajo del día a día es reparación general: frenos, aire acondicionado, diagnóstico y mantenimiento de cualquier marca.
parrafo_2.en: The shop built its name among Corvette owners who found it recommended on specialty forums, but the day to day work is general repair: brakes, A/C, diagnostics, and maintenance on any make.

eyebrow.es: De la llamada a las llaves
eyebrow.en: From the call to the keys

texto.es: Nos cuentas qué le pasa a tu auto. Sin formularios ni centro de llamadas, hablas directo con el taller.
texto.en: Tell us what's going on with your car. No forms, no call center, you talk directly to the shop.

texto.es: Bob revisa el auto y te explica el problema en claro. Si algo no hace falta repararlo, te lo dice igual.
texto.en: Bob looks over the car and explains the problem in plain terms. If something doesn't need fixing, he tells you that too.

texto.es: Sabes el precio antes de que empecemos. Nada de sorpresas en la factura final.
texto.en: You know the price before we start. No surprises on the final bill.

texto.es: El trabajo se hace en el taller, con el mismo mecánico de principio a fin.
texto.en: The work gets done right here in the shop, with the same mechanic from start to finish.

nota.es: Cada reparación empieza con una revisión honesta y en persona. Llámanos y te decimos claro qué necesita tu auto y cuánto cuesta.
nota.en: Every repair starts with an honest, in person look at your car. Call us and we will tell you straight what it needs and what it costs.

texto.es: El taller se corrió de boca en boca entre dueños de Corvette. Diagnóstico certero en modelos que otros talleres no resuelven.
texto.en: Word spread among Corvette owners who needed problems other shops couldn't solve. Straight answers on the models that give dealerships trouble.

texto.es: Frenos, motor, suspensión y el chequeo de esa luz que no se apaga. Cualquier marca, explicado en claro.
texto.en: Brakes, engine, suspension, and the check engine light that won't go off. Any make, explained in plain terms.

texto.es: Si el aire no enfría como debería en Florida, lo revisamos y arreglamos sin adivinar.
texto.en: If your A/C isn't keeping up with Florida heat, we find the real issue and fix it, no guessing.

texto.es: También entran a nuestros elevadores los clásicos: del Ford del 50 al muscle car que no se toca con cualquiera.
texto.en: Classics come through our lifts too, from a 1950s Ford to a muscle car you don't hand to just anyone.

pie.es: ¿No ves tu problema en la lista? Llama igual, es probable que Bob ya lo haya visto antes.
pie.en: Don't see your issue on this list? Call anyway, chances are Bob has already seen it before.

items.quote: Bob was super helpful and knowledgeable. He does not just start replacing parts, he tells you his best advice even if it's do nothing. I appreciate the straight forward approach. 2008 C6. Thank you!

Bob's the man for your Vette. I brought in my 06 C6 that dealership mechanics couldn't fix. Bob fixed it, charged a reasonable rate, and he's a great guy to work with. Very knowledgeable with Corvettes, and honest.

Bob Miller's Auto Repair is like having a relative in the automotive repair business, knowledgeable and upfront about the problem and the cost. My A/C has never worked better. Thank you very much, we appreciate you.
